title: Old token helper scripts using the out-of-band OAuth flow no longer work
symptoms: Token helper never shows a code to paste
cause: Google retired the out-of-band (copy and paste code) flow. Scripts written for it fail at the consent step.
fix: Use a loopback redirect. Desktop OAuth clients accept http://localhost on any port. Request offline access and force the consent prompt so a refresh token is returned.
apply: Auth URL params: redirect_uri=http://localhost:5051&access_type=offline&prompt=consent; run a local HTTP listener on 5051 to capture the code, then exchange it at https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token
